subject: Term & Renewal language — MSA redlines (proposal + decision log)
messages:
From: Elena Marcus <elena.marcus@brightline.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@brightline.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Questions on Term & Renewal language (MSA redlines)

Marcus —

Thanks for sending the draft MSA copy. We reviewed the redlines and Brightline legal has a couple of asks on the Term / Renewal section before we can move to signatures. Key points below: 

- Auto-renew: the current draft has a 12-month renewal term with automatic renewal unless notice given 90 days before end of term. For Brightline internal policy we usually require a 60-day notice. Would Redwood consider shortening to 60 days for Enterprise-tier customers?

- Termination for Convenience (TFC): our GC prefers a mutual TFC with a cap on liquidated damages. We can accept a 60-day service wind-down and an agreed pro-rated refund, but need clarity on any early termination fees — our redline proposes a fixed fee not to exceed 25% of remaining committed fees.

- Data handback: please confirm retention timeline and whether Redwood will provide a one-time export within 30 days after termination without extra charge.

I attached Brightline_MSA_redline_20270520.docx with inline comments. Could you share Redwood's preferred compromises so we can capture on the document? If it's easier, we can do a 20–30 minute handoff call next week.

Thanks,
Elena Marcus
Senior Counsel, Brightline
attachments: Brightline_MSA_redline_20270520.docx

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Marcus <elena.marcus@brightline.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Questions on Term & Renewal language (MSA redlines)

Elena —

Appreciate the clear notes and the marked-up doc. I've reviewed with Sales + Legal triage and sketched two compromise tracks below so Brightline can pick which aligns best with your procurement timeline. I attached a short PDF with tracked suggestions (Redwood_Term_Suggestion_v1.pdf).

Option A — Enterprise compromise (preferred):
- Auto-renew notice: 60 days for Enterprise accounts (we'll leave standard 90-day for self-serve / lower tiers).
- TFC: mutual termination for convenience permitted; fee equal to remaining committed fees capped at 20% if termination occurs in first 6 months of a 12-mo term, pro-rated thereafter. 60-day wind-down and standard data export provided at no charge.

Option B — Product-side compromise (safer for Redwood):
- Auto-renew notice: keep 90 days but allow Brightline to opt into a 60-day exception by written amendment tied to the Enterprise pricing schedule.
- TFC: mutual but cap at 30% of remaining committed fees for early termination; data export available within 30 days with standard export fee waived for the first instance.

Next steps I propose:
1) If you prefer Option A we can mark that directly into the MSA and Karthik will coordinate a final legal pass.
2) If Option B is more realistic for your procurement, I'll send the amendment language and we can route for signature.
3) Schedule a quick call to run through one live example of the fee math so both sides have the same expectation.

Quick note on timing: if Brightline wants the 60-day notice universally we need an exec sign-off (we've flagged to our contracting committee). If it's scoped to Enterprise (Option A) we can accept as part of the order form.

Available slots: Tue 5/25 10:00–11:00 PT, Wed 5/26 14:00–15:00 PT. Which works for you?

Best,
Marcus Lin
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0198
attachments: Redwood_Term_Suggestion_v1.pdf

Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Term & Renewal language — MSA redlines (proposal + decision log)

Elena / Marcus —

Thanks for the options, Marcus. Internal note for the thread (capturing decision log so legal and procurement have a single source of truth):
- Agreed compromise: accept Option A scoped to Enterprise accounts only. That means Brightline (Enterprise SKU on deal HB-2283-BR) will get 60-day auto-renew notice and the TFC structure defined below.
- TFC final language (to be added to MSA): "Either party may terminate for convenience upon thirty (30) days' written notice; if Customer terminates for convenience during the initial twelve (12) month term, Customer shall pay an early termination fee equal to the lesser of (a) twenty percent (20%) of the remaining committed fees or (b) the pro-rated fees for the remainder of the term." 60-day wind-down operational support retained.
- Data handback: Redwood will provide one-time export within thirty (30) days of termination at no charge; retention policy unchanged (30 days accessible archive, 90 days full export window).

Elena: if you confirm, we'll insert the exact paragraph into your redline and prepare the updated MSA + order form. I'm linking the HubSpot record and DocuSign envelope here for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/2283 and https://www.docusign.net/BRIGHTLINE/EnvelopeID/abc123.

Once you confirm, legal (Laura) will drop the final markup and we can route for signatures. Marcus — please schedule the call only if Elena wants to walk the fee example live; otherwise I'll push the redline later today.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Commercial Contracts, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
